links.outcome: Model performance across sex and anemia-status subgroups
links.effect: Subgroup analysis showed lower performance in male and nonanemic populations; overall AUROC exceeded 0.94.
links.quote: Subgroup analysis showed lower performance in male and nonanemic populations.

links.outcome: Model performance across three hospital sites
links.effect: Validated across 3 hospitals with ID prevalence 17.4% to 19.6%; AUROC exceeded 0.94 and AUPRC exceeded 0.83 during validation.
links.quote: The ML model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) exceeding 0.94 and a precision-recall curve values (AUPRC) exceeding 0.83 during validation.

screen.reason: The study validates and prospectively integrates an ML model into clinical workflows for iron deficiency detection, tracking real-world performance metrics without explicitly testing a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
